question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Done without conscious control; unintentional
solution:
The correct answer is **"Involuntary."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Involuntary"** means done without conscious control or unintentional. (बिना चाहे या मंशा के किया गया; अनैच्छिक, अनभिप्रेत)

 
 
• **Example**: *His **involuntary**__ reaction to the loud noise startled everyone in the room.*
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word **"involuntarius" **which means "not done of one's own free will."
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - Invincible** means impossible to defeat or overcome. (इतना सशक्त या बलशाली कि पराजित न किया जा सके; अपराजेय, अजेय)
 
• **Option 3 - Invitro** means relating to a process or procedure conducted outside a living organism, typically in a test tube or culture medium. (किसी जीवित जीव के बाहर, आमतौर पर टेस्ट ट्यूब या कल्चर माध्यम में आयोजित प्रक्रिया या प्रक्रिया से संबंधित)
 
• **Option 4 - Invoke** means to call upon a higher power or authority for help or support. ((किसी कार्य के समर्थन में) नियम, क़ानून आदि प्रयोग करना)
